messages.content: Compare one RAW video micro-action with one final H3 micro-action. Return only JSON with one field status. Allowed: PRESERVED, OMITTED, CHANGED.

RAW MICRO-ACTION:
The robot welds the cracked pipe shut.

FINAL H3 MICRO-ACTION:
The robot inspects the cracked pipe.

Return only {"status":"PRESERVED|OMITTED|CHANGED"}.
